conditions.runtime: Test JEM quality-of-life branch only until explicit promotion

change.summary: Correct verified catalog families, add standalone immediate Exposure photographs, surface unresolved enchantments, and normalize player-facing duration text

modifiers.before: Fairy Lights pennants, Handcrafted bedding and desks, spell scrolls, and death-prevention totems could fall into building, books, miscellaneous, or other noncanonical categories
modifiers.after: Verified Fairy Lights and Handcrafted families use furniture or holiday categories, the single data-driven Iron's scroll item uses weapons, and native-tagged or exact death-prevention totems use wearables

modifiers.before: Exposure requires film development before photographs and exposes high-sensitivity film, Lightroom, and Interplanar Projector recipe paths
modifiers.after: Simpler Exposure delivers one native Photograph after each successful native frame, permits only regular color and black-and-white film, supports configurable capacity from 1 to 16, and suppresses obsolete normal-survival recipes while retaining old saved content

modifiers.before: A newly loaded registry enchantment without an authored record could be omitted silently
modifiers.after: The loaded registry is compared with verified bilingual records on resource reload and every unresolved registry ID is reported in the tooltip and log

modifiers.before: Some handbook and tooltip text exposed fractional Minecraft-day values for short durations
modifiers.after: Short player-facing durations use whole seconds or minutes, calendar-scale values use whole Minecraft days, and native timing units remain unchanged internally

cause.owner: JEM catalog, Guidebook, presentation owners, and standalone Simpler Exposure

relations: installed registry and native API evidence -> canonical JEM owner -> client presentation
notes: Exposure remains the owner of camera capture, frame metadata, image storage, camera controls, networking, and camera stand behavior
Existing Exposure items, blocks, block entities, frames, and photographs are retained
Gameplay durations, saved values, configuration values, and packet units are not changed by presentation formatting
unresolved: No build, launch, automated validation, gameplay test, or player acceptance was performed because the user explicitly prohibited all testing and green checks for this task
